qualification: Fresh independent single-transaction holdouts on the pinned deployed FeeShare ELF. Local creator/referrer substitutions use disposable Ed25519 signers; positive fee/vault accrual and all recipient ATAs are synthetic. Both Borsh Option<Pubkey> layouts, odd accruals, zero/None/cap/overcap, outsider and invalid entity were compared against native Rust. Account validation, SPL CPI failure states, referrer redemption, initialization, fee accrual and other handlers are not modeled. No live transaction or source-equivalence claim.
